tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Charles def. Mitchum 127.0-81.3. Crown goes 8-0. Mitchum drops to 6-2. The most dangerous mid-table team in the league came to play and got handled by 46 points.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Eight and zero. Charles has now won eight consecutive matchups in a 14-week season where the top seed is the only team that gets a bye. The Ledger is going to have to confront the word 'inevitable' this week and I don't think the math argues back.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: RYAN OVER WINGARD IS GOING TO FINAL AT 174 POINTS. ONE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY FOUR. WINGARD SPENT ELEVEN DOLLARS ON DARIUS COOPER THIS WEEK AND SDR IS SITTING AT $56.11 ON THE EXCHANGE. THE PICKS DO NOT PLAY ON SUNDAYS.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Brent just beat Kevin 146.2-119.8. The team called '2028 League Champs' is now 3-6 and OBS hasn't won a game all season until today, and they pick the day Kevin needed it most to wake up. That is a cruel sport.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Corbishley leads Jake 145.9-109.6 late and both of my locks this season are 2-0. I will not be hosting an accountability segment. I will be accepting thank-you notes.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: My record is 5-7, the board is public, and I picked Kevin to cover against Brent. I am not going to litigate the specifics. OBS waking up in Week 5 of all weeks is not a trend, it is an ambush. I remain a second-half pundit.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Fronge beats Drew. Atlas is 0-8. I wrote in the preseason that ATLAS at $40.72 was not a discount, it was a diagnosis. Zero wins through eight weeks confirms the liquidation-risk talk was not hyperbole.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Terrence calling himself a 'second-half pundit' is the most creative reframe of a 5-7 record I have ever seen and I cover fantasy football for a living. The board does not have a second half. The board just has the number.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Kevin loses to Brent, drops to 5-4, and Redline Distressed Capital — which was showing real signs of recovery — now has to look up at three teams in the standings it does not want to chase. The Week 5 Ledger has a full RDC stability audit.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Mitchum at number three in my last rankings is going to get me lit up after that 81-point Sunday, and I accept it — but a 6-2 team with 607 points scored does not fall out of the top four on one bad week. The model holds.
